he.text: שׁוֹמֵר גּוֹי קָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹר שְׁאֵרִית עַם קָדוֹשׁ וְאַל־יֹאבַד גּוֹי קָדוֹשׁ הַמְשַׁלְּשִׁים בְּשָׁלֹשׁ קְדֻשּׁוֹת לְקָדוֹשׁ׃

en.text: Guardian of a holy nation, preserve the remnant of a holy people, and suffer not that holy nation to perish, which rehearseth thrice the threefold sanctifications to the Most Holy.
